chunks: The great Shaykh Abu Ja'far Muhammad ibn Ali ibn al-Husayn ibn Musa ibn Babuwayh al-Qummi (may God be pleased with him) narrated to us, saying: Ali ibn Ahmad ibn Musa al-Daqqaq (may God be pleased with him) narrated to us, saying: Muhammad ibn Abi Abdillah al-Kufi narrated to us, saying: Abu Sa'id Sahl ibn Ziyad al-Adami al-Razi narrated to us, saying: Abd al-Azim ibn Abdillah al-Hasani narrated to me, saying: I heard Muhammad ibn Ali al-Rida (peace be upon him) say:
No one visits my father (peace be upon him) and is afflicted by hardship from rain, cold, or heat, except that God makes his body forbidden to the Fire.

key_terms.النَّارِ: The Fire (Hell) — the place of punishment in the afterlife
key_terms.حَرَّمَ: Made forbidden, made sacred — denotes God's act of making something inviolable
key_terms.زَارَ: Visited, made pilgrimage (ziyarah) — the act of devotional visitation to the shrine of a holy figure

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for visiting the shrine of Imam al-Rida according to Imam al-Jawad?
ai.summary: In this hadith from the ninety-fourth assembly of al-Amali, dictated by Shaykh al-Saduq in Mashhad in 368 AH, Imam Muhammad al-Jawad (the 9th Imam, peace be upon him) conveys the spiritual reward for visiting the shrine of his father, Imam Ali al-Rida (the 8th Imam, peace be upon him). The Imam states that whoever undertakes the pilgrimage (ziyarah) to his father's resting place and endures hardship from weather conditions -- whether rain, cold, or heat -- God will make that person's body forbidden to the Hellfire. This teaching, delivered through a chain of five narrators, highlights the enormous spiritual merit that Shi'i tradition attaches to visiting the shrine in Mashhad, particularly when the visit involves physical sacrifice and perseverance through difficult conditions. The hadith reflects the broader Shi'i theological principle that devotional acts performed with sincere effort and personal cost carry proportionally greater divine reward.

en.bilal-muhammad: Abu Ja`far Muhammad b. `Ali b. al-Husayn b. Musa b. Babuwayh al-Qummi (ra) narrated to us. He said: `Ali b. Ahmad b. Musa al-Daqqaq (ra) narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. Abi `Abdillah al-Kufi narrated to us. He said: Abu Sa`id Sahl b. Ziyad al-Adami al-Razi narrated to us. He said: Abd al-`Athim b. `Abdullah al-Hasani narrated to us. He said: I heard Muhammad b. `Ali al-Rida (as) say:
Whoever visits my father (as) and is afflicted by any harm from rain, cold, or heat, Allah will forbid the Fire from his body.
